# SurfaceV2

Implementation not yet deployed to Ethereum mainnet; the address lands here at launch.

> Second generation of the sequential collection, deployed per artist as an EIP-1167 clone of the implementation above through the [v2 factory](/docs/surface/contracts/factory-v2). A collection has no canonical address of its own; substitute your collection address for `<COLLECTION_ADDRESS>` in the examples below. This is a separate deployment from [Surface](/docs/surface/contracts/surface); the two coexist and neither depends on the other.

Second generation of the sequential-id ERC721 collection: the token core of the
Surface v2 art protocol. It stores ownership, one seed per token, the renderer
pointer, the EIP-2981 royalty, creator attribution, and the supply cap. It holds
no sale logic and no ETH: it has no payable function, and every mint enters
through an authorized minter calling one of the two non-payable mint entrypoints.
Each collection is a separate EIP-1167 clone deployed by
[the v2 factory](/docs/surface/contracts/factory-v2); there is no proxy admin and
no upgrade path. This is a separate deployment from
[Surface](/docs/surface/contracts/surface); the two coexist, and v2 has one id
mode instead of two.

Price, mint window, payment, referral, and gating live in the minter that calls
the mint entrypoints, not in the token. `createSurface` on the v2 factory clones
and grants a
[FixedPriceMinterV2](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter-v2); a project
with its own economics grants its own minter contract instead. The owner
controls a minter through `setMinter` (grant or revoke) and `lockMinter` (freeze
the set). `primaryMinter` is a separate frontend-discovery pointer at one granted
minter, the one a generic client reads and calls first; `isMinter` is the full
authorization check every granted minter passes equally.

Four one-way locks cover the state the token owns: `lockRenderer` pins the
renderer pointer, `lockSupply` freezes the cap, `lockMinter` freezes the minter
set, and `lockRoyalty` freezes the royalty. `seal` engages every remaining lock
and renounces ownership in one call. Per-token provenance is the seed, read with
`tokenSeed`, plus the `Minted` event, which records the minter, recipient, and id
range for each mint.

## Concepts

### Token and minter

The token authorizes a minter for one of two operations: `mintTo` or
`mintToSeeded`. It does not constrain minter internals. The token-side
invariants hold for every minter: the supply cap bounds all mints, ids are
assigned sequentially, and each mint emits `Minted` with the calling minter.
Payment, referral, and gating are the minter's own surface; see
[FixedPriceMinterV2](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter-v2) and the
[minter guide](/docs/surface/guides/write-a-minter).

### Primary minter

`primaryMinter` names one granted minter as the frontend-discovery default, so a
generic client can go from a collection address to its intended mint module
without enumerating every grant. It is metadata, not a payment router: minting
still calls the named minter directly, and every other granted minter is equally
callable through `isMinter`. The owner or admin sets it with `setPrimaryMinter`,
which reverts `MinterIsLocked` once `lockMinter` has run; revoking the current
primary through `setMinter` clears the pointer to zero. `initialize` seeds the
pointer from `InitParamsV2`, validated against `initialMinters`. Every change
emits `PrimaryMinterSet`.

### Owner and admins

The owner may grant admin keys with `addAdmin`. An admin can call every
management function the owner can except managing the admin set and
transferring ownership. A grant records the granting owner and is valid only
while that account is the current owner, so an ownership transfer invalidates
every grant. Companion contracts reuse this authority: the canonical minter's
config setters check the collection's `owner()`/`isAdmin`.

### Creator attribution

Attribution is a two-sided onchain check with no shared registry write. The
owner lists creators with `setCreators`, an assertion. A listed creator confirms
by claiming the collection in the [Catalog](/docs/catalog/contracts/catalog)
from their own address. `isConfirmedCreator(who)` is the intersection: listed and
claimed. Either side can retract, and the confirmation follows on the next read;
nothing is stored. `owner()` counts as a creator without being listed; listing
is for co-creators.

### One id mode

v2 has one collection form: ids are assigned 1, 2, 3... in mint order and not
reused after a burn, so the id equals the mint order. The supply cap bounds
mints ever. `mintTo` and `mintToSeeded` are batch-native: one call mints a
contiguous id range and emits one `Minted`. `burn` is owner-or-approved.
`idMode()` stays as a compatibility read for renderers built against v1's
`ISurfaceView` and always returns Sequential; see
[id modes](/docs/surface/concepts/id-modes).

### Seeds

Each mint resolves one `bytes32` per token, read with `tokenSeed`. `mintTo`
derives it: `keccak256(prevrandao, collection, tokenId)`, per
`docs/injection-convention.md`. The recipient is not in the formula, so the
seed does not depend on the minter. `mintToSeeded` lets the calling minter
supply each token's seed directly; a zero entry falls back to the same
derivation. A nonzero supplied seed is stored and takes precedence over
`seedSource` for that token. A work needing other mint-time data (the mint
block, pooled order) records it in its own minter; the mint block of any token
is the `Minted` log's block.

### seedSource

An optional external seed provider, set once at `initialize` with no setter and
no lock: it can never change after deploy. When set, a token with no stored
seed resolves through `ISeedSourceV2(seedSource).seedOf(collection, tokenId)`
instead of the default derivation, so `mintTo` skips writing a seed for that
token. A source may revert, for example a reveal-based source queried before
its epoch resolves. A minter-supplied nonzero seed from `mintToSeeded` always
wins over the source for that token.

### Locks and sealing

`lockRenderer` (optional) pins the renderer pointer. The token does not verify
a renderer's internals, so a locked pointer at an immutable renderer fixes
presentation, while a locked pointer at a mutable renderer leaves that
renderer's output changeable. `lockSupply` freezes the supply cap, which bounds
every mint path. `lockMinter` freezes the minter set. `lockRoyalty` freezes the
royalty bps and receiver; if the receiver is still the zero sentinel, locking
snapshots the current `owner()` as the receiver first, so the locked payee is a
fixed address rather than a live read.

`seal` is owner-only and engages every lock that is not already engaged, then
renounces ownership, in one transaction. `permanence()` reports all four locks
plus whether the collection is sealed (`owner() == address(0)`) and the
implementation version. Sealing with zero granted minters permanently ends
minting, because every mint goes through an authorized minter.

### Self-custody guard

`transferFrom` and both `safeTransferFrom` overloads reject sending a token to
the collection's own address, reverting `SelfCustodyRejected`. The collection
has no code path to move a token back out of itself, so a token landed there
would be stranded permanently.

### Live reads

```bash
# Live supply (minted minus burned)
cast call <COLLECTION_ADDRESS> "totalSupply()(uint256)" \
  --rpc-url https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com

# The active renderer
cast call <COLLECTION_ADDRESS> "renderer()(address)" \
  --rpc-url https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com

# Whether an address may mint
cast call <COLLECTION_ADDRESS> "isMinter(address)(bool)" <MINTER_ADDRESS> \
  --rpc-url https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com

# Every one-way lock plus renounce state, in one call
cast call <COLLECTION_ADDRESS> "permanence()(bool,bool,bool,bool,bool,uint256)" \
  --rpc-url https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com
```

A collection is a per-artist clone with no canonical address, so the examples
use a `<COLLECTION_ADDRESS>` placeholder. Collection addresses come from the
v2 factory's `SurfaceCreated` events.

## Write functions

### mintTo

```solidity
function mintTo(address to, uint256 quantity) external returns (uint256 firstTokenId)
```

**Access:** minter-only (`msg.sender` must be an authorized minter, else `NotMinter`)

The default mint entrypoint. Non-payable: the calling minter handles payment
before calling. Mints `quantity` tokens to `to` with ids
`firstTokenId .. firstTokenId + quantity - 1`, where `firstTokenId` is one past
the mints-ever count, deriving each token's seed, and returns `firstTokenId`.
One call, one `Minted` event. Reverts `ZeroQuantity` for `quantity == 0` and
`ExceedsCap` when the batch would cross the supply cap. Uses `_mint`, not
`_safeMint`, so a contract recipient is not called.

### mintToSeeded

```solidity
function mintToSeeded(address to, bytes32[] seeds) external returns (uint256 firstTokenId)
```

**Access:** minter-only (`msg.sender` must be an authorized minter, else `NotMinter`)

Same id assignment as `mintTo`, but the caller supplies each token's seed:
`seeds.length` is the quantity, and a zero entry derives the default seed for
that token instead of taking a literal seed. A nonzero entry is stored and
takes precedence over `seedSource` for that token. Reverts `ZeroQuantity` for
an empty array and `ExceedsCap` when the batch would cross the supply cap.
Emits the same `Minted` event as `mintTo`.

### burn

```solidity
function burn(uint256 tokenId) external
```

**Access:** owner-or-approved (else `NotAuthorized`)

Burns a token and decrements live supply. Reverts `ERC721NonexistentToken` for
an id that is not currently minted. A burn does not free supply-cap capacity.
The burned token's seed stays readable. Emits `Burned`.

### setRenderer

```solidity
function setRenderer(address renderer_) external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

Sets the renderer pointer. Reverts `RendererIsLocked` after `lockRenderer`,
`RendererRequired` for the zero address, and `RendererNotContract` for an
address with no code. Emits `RendererSet`, an ERC-4906 `BatchMetadataUpdate`
over all tokens, and an ERC-7572 `ContractURIUpdated`.

### setRoyalty

```solidity
function setRoyalty(uint16 royaltyBps, address royaltyReceiver) external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

Sets the EIP-2981 royalty read by `royaltyInfo`. Capped at 50%
(`RoyaltyTooHigh` above 5000 bps); a zero receiver resolves to `owner()` at
read time. Reverts `RoyaltyIsLocked` after `lockRoyalty`. Emits `RoyaltySet`.

### lockRoyalty

```solidity
function lockRoyalty() external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

One-way: locks the royalty bps and receiver. If the receiver is still the zero
sentinel, this snapshots the current `owner()` as the receiver first, so the
locked payee is a fixed address rather than a live read of `owner()`. Reverts
`RoyaltyIsLocked` if already locked. Emits `RoyaltyLocked`, and `RoyaltySet` if
it snapshots a receiver.

### setSupplyCap

```solidity
function setSupplyCap(uint256 supplyCap) external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

Sets the supply cap; 0 means open supply. Reverts `SupplyIsLocked` after
`lockSupply`, and `BadSupplyCap` for a nonzero cap below mints-ever. The cap
determines which token carries a renderer's final-mint trait, so the call also
emits a full-range `BatchMetadataUpdate` with `SupplyCapSet`.

### setCreators

```solidity
function setCreators(address[] list, bool listed) external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

Lists (`listed = true`) or unlists creators, the owner's side of attribution. A
listing is an assertion; a creator is confirmed once they also claim the
collection in the Catalog. Emits `CreatorListed` per address.

### setMinter

```solidity
function setMinter(address minter, bool allowed) external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

Grants (`allowed = true`) or revokes an authorized minter. Reverts
`ZeroMinter` for the zero address and `MinterIsLocked` after `lockMinter`; a
call that does not change the state is a no-op. Any number of minters may be
granted at once. Emits `MinterSet`.

### setPrimaryMinter

```solidity
function setPrimaryMinter(address minter) external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

Repoints the frontend-discovery default at `minter`, or clears it with the
zero address. Reverts `MinterIsLocked` once `lockMinter` has run, and
`PrimaryMinterNotAuthorized` for a nonzero target that is not currently
granted. Emits `PrimaryMinterSet`.

### lockRenderer

```solidity
function lockRenderer() external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

One-way: pins the renderer pointer, so `tokenURI`/`contractURI` are answered by
the current renderer from then on. The token does not verify a renderer's
internals: a locked pointer at an immutable renderer fixes presentation, while
a locked pointer at a mutable renderer leaves that renderer's output
changeable. Reverts `RendererIsLocked` if already locked. Emits
`RendererLocked`.

### lockSupply

```solidity
function lockSupply() external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

One-way: freezes the supply cap. The cap bounds every mint path, so no later
minter grant can exceed it. Reverts `SupplyIsLocked` if already locked. Emits
`SupplyLocked`.

### lockMinter

```solidity
function lockMinter() external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

One-way: freezes the minter set, so no minter is granted or revoked
afterward. Every minter granted before the lock keeps its authority. Locking
with zero minters granted leaves the collection permanently unable to mint.
Reverts `MinterIsLocked` if already locked. Emits `MinterLocked`.

### seal

```solidity
function seal() external
```

**Access:** owner-only (`onlyOwner`, else `OwnableUnauthorizedAccount`)

One transaction: engages every un-engaged lock (renderer, supply, minter,
royalty), then renounces ownership. Sealing with zero granted minters
permanently ends minting, because every mint goes through an authorized
minter. Emits a lock event per lock it engages, and
`OwnershipTransferred` for the renounce.

### addAdmin

```solidity
function addAdmin(address account) external
```

**Access:** owner-only (`onlyOwner`, else `OwnableUnauthorizedAccount`)

Grants an admin key. An admin can call every management function the owner can
except managing the admin set and transferring ownership. Reverts
`ZeroAccount` for the zero address and `AlreadyAdmin` for an existing admin or
the owner (already an admin). A grant records the granting owner and stops
being valid once ownership transfers. Emits `AdminSet`.

### removeAdmin

```solidity
function removeAdmin(address account) external
```

**Access:** owner, or the admin itself (else `NotAuthorized`)

Revokes an admin. The owner may remove any admin; an admin may remove itself by
passing its own address. Reverts `NotAnAdmin` when the account holds no grant.
Emits `AdminSet`.

### notifyMetadataUpdate

```solidity
function notifyMetadataUpdate(uint256 fromTokenId, uint256 toTokenId) external
```

**Access:** the current renderer, or owner/admin (else `NotAuthorized`)

Emits an ERC-4906 `BatchMetadataUpdate` for metadata changes the token cannot
observe: an onchain-live work whose output changed with chain state, a reveal,
new captures. The event is emitted on the token, so the renderer calls this
rather than emitting its own. Event only; no state change. Works after
`lockRenderer`, which pins the renderer address, not its output.

### rescueStrayETH

```solidity
function rescueStrayETH(address to) external
```

**Access:** owner or admin (`onlyOwnerOrAdmin`, else `NotAuthorized`)

Sends `to` the contract's full ETH balance. The token has no payable function,
so any balance was force-fed (selfdestruct or a pre-funded address) and
nothing is owed. Reverts `ZeroAccount` for the zero address, `NoStrayETH` for a
zero balance, and `RescueFailed` if the transfer reverts. Emits
`StrayETHRescued`.

### initialize

```solidity
function initialize(InitParamsV2 p) external
```

**Access:** deployer one-shot (`initializer`, else `InvalidInitialization`)

Sets the clone up once: name, symbol, owner, the `SurfaceConfig`, the
factory's default renderer (used when the config names none), initial
minters, the primary minter, the Catalog address, an initial creator listing,
and the `seedSource` fallback. Reverts `OwnerRequired` for a zero owner,
`RoyaltyTooHigh` above the 50% cap, `RendererRequired` when neither the config
nor the factory supplies a renderer, `RendererNotContract` for a renderer with
no code, `SeedSourceNotContract` for a nonzero seed source with no code,
`ZeroMinter` for a zero address among the initial minters, and
`PrimaryMinterNotAuthorized` for a nonzero primary minter that is not among
the initial minters. Locks passed true in the config apply from init. The
implementation constructor disables initializers, so only a clone is
initialized, once. Emits `MinterSet` per initial minter, `PrimaryMinterSet`
when a primary is set, `CreatorListed` per listed creator, lock events for
locks set at init, and `SurfaceConfigured`.

### transferOwnership

```solidity
function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external
```

**Access:** owner-only (`onlyOwner`, else `OwnableUnauthorizedAccount`)

OpenZeppelin Ownable2Step: records a pending owner who must call
`acceptOwnership`. Existing admin grants stop being valid once the transfer
completes. Emits `OwnershipTransferStarted`.

### acceptOwnership

```solidity
function acceptOwnership() external
```

**Access:** pending-owner-only (else `OwnableUnauthorizedAccount`)

Ownable2Step: the pending owner completes the transfer and becomes owner.
Admin grants made by the previous owner are no longer valid. Emits
`OwnershipTransferred`.

### renounceOwnership

```solidity
function renounceOwnership() external
```

**Access:** owner-only (`onlyOwner`, else `OwnableUnauthorizedAccount`)

OpenZeppelin Ownable: sets the owner to the zero address. Every owner and
admin gate then reverts (an admin grant is valid only while its granting owner
is the current owner), and the config is fixed at its current values. A
royalty receiver left at zero then reports the zero address. One-way. `seal`
calls this as its last step.

### approve

```solidity
function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external
```

**Access:** owner-or-operator-only (standard ERC721 approval authority, else an `ERC721` revert)

Standard ERC721 single-token approval. Emits `Approval`.

### setApprovalForAll

```solidity
function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external
```

**Access:** permissionless (the caller sets its own operator approval)

Standard ERC721 operator approval over all of the caller's tokens. Emits
`ApprovalForAll`.

### transferFrom

```solidity
function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external
```

**Access:** owner-or-approved-only (standard ERC721 transfer authority, else `ERC721InsufficientApproval`)

Standard ERC721 transfer. Reverts `SelfCustodyRejected` when `to` is this
collection's own address. Emits `Transfer`.

### safeTransferFrom(address, address, uint256)

```solidity
function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external
```

**Access:** owner-or-approved-only (standard ERC721 transfer authority, else `ERC721InsufficientApproval`)

Standard ERC721 safe transfer with no data. Checks a contract recipient
implements `onERC721Received` (`ERC721InvalidReceiver` otherwise). Reverts
`SelfCustodyRejected` when `to` is this collection's own address. Emits
`Transfer`.

### safeTransferFrom(address, address, uint256, bytes)

```solidity
function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes data) external
```

**Access:** owner-or-approved-only (standard ERC721 transfer authority, else `ERC721InsufficientApproval`)

Standard ERC721 safe transfer with a data payload forwarded to the recipient's
`onERC721Received`. Reverts `SelfCustodyRejected` when `to` is this
collection's own address. Emits `Transfer`.

## Read functions

### balanceOf

```solidity
function balanceOf(address owner) external view returns (uint256)
```

Standard ERC721: the number of tokens an address owns.

### catalog

```solidity
function catalog() external view returns (address)
```

The Catalog singleton this collection confirms creators against (zero when
confirmation is disabled).

### config

```solidity
function config() external view returns (SurfaceConfig cfg, uint256 minted)
```

Returns the live [`SurfaceConfig`](/docs/surface/concepts/types) and
`minted`, the mints-ever count (not live supply). Setters edit the config
fields in place, so this view always reports what the contract uses. Sale
state (price, window, phase) is not here; read the collection's minter.

### contractURI

```solidity
function contractURI() external view returns (string)
```

Collection-level metadata, delegated to the renderer's `contractURI`.

### getApproved

```solidity
function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address)
```

Standard ERC721: the single-token approved spender, or zero.

### idMode

```solidity
function idMode() external pure returns (IdMode)
```

Compatibility read for renderers built against v1's `ISurfaceView`: always
Sequential. Not a mutable setting; v2 has one id mode. See
[id modes](/docs/surface/concepts/id-modes).

### isAdmin

```solidity
function isAdmin(address account) external view returns (bool)
```

True if the account may use the admin-gated setters: the owner, or an address
holding a currently valid grant. The owner is included because every
admin-gated function also admits the owner.

### isApprovedForAll

```solidity
function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) external view returns (bool)
```

Standard ERC721: whether an operator is approved over all of an owner's
tokens.

### isConfirmedCreator

```solidity
function isConfirmedCreator(address who) external view returns (bool)
```

True only if the owner has listed `who` and `who` has claimed this collection
in the Catalog (`isContractRegistered`). Computed on read, so retracting
either side revokes the confirmation. False when no Catalog is configured.

### isListedCreator

```solidity
function isListedCreator(address) external view returns (bool)
```

Whether the owner has listed `who` as a creator (the owner's assertion). See
`isConfirmedCreator`.

### isMinter

```solidity
function isMinter(address minter) external view returns (bool)
```

True if the address is an authorized minter allowed to call a mint
entrypoint.

### isMinterLocked

```solidity
function isMinterLocked() external view returns (bool)
```

True after `lockMinter`.

### isRendererLocked

```solidity
function isRendererLocked() external view returns (bool)
```

True after `lockRenderer`.

### isRoyaltyLocked

```solidity
function isRoyaltyLocked() external view returns (bool)
```

True after `lockRoyalty`.

### isSupplyLocked

```solidity
function isSupplyLocked() external view returns (bool)
```

True after `lockSupply`.

### name

```solidity
function name() external view returns (string)
```

Standard ERC721 collection name, set at init.

### owner

```solidity
function owner() external view returns (address)
```

Standard OpenZeppelin Ownable owner: the address that controls the config, the
minter set, and the admin set.

### ownerOf

```solidity
function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address)
```

Standard ERC721: the owner of a token. Reverts `ERC721NonexistentToken` for an
id that is not currently minted.

### pendingOwner

```solidity
function pendingOwner() external view returns (address)
```

Standard Ownable2Step pending owner: the address offered ownership that must
call `acceptOwnership`, or zero when no transfer is pending.

### permanence

```solidity
function permanence() external view returns (bool rendererLocked, bool supplyLocked, bool minterLocked, bool royaltyLocked, bool sealed_, uint256 version_)
```

Snapshot of every one-way lock (renderer, supply, minter, royalty) plus
renounce state and the implementation version, in one call. `sealed_` is
`owner() == address(0)`.

### primaryMinter

```solidity
function primaryMinter() external view returns (address)
```

The frontend-discovery default: the minter a generic client should read and
call first. Not proof that no other authorized minter exists; every granted
minter in `isMinter` is equally callable. Zero when none is set. Set via
`setPrimaryMinter` and cleared when the current primary is revoked.

### renderer

```solidity
function renderer() external view returns (address)
```

The renderer address `tokenURI` and `contractURI` delegate to. Set at init
(the config's value, or the factory default when the config names none) and
settable via `setRenderer` until `lockRenderer`.

### royaltyInfo

```solidity
function royaltyInfo(uint256, uint256 salePrice) external view returns (address receiver, uint256 royaltyAmount)
```

EIP-2981 royalty for a sale price: the receiver (the configured receiver, or
`owner()` when unset) and the amount from `royaltyBps`. Advisory.

### seedSource

```solidity
function seedSource() external view returns (address)
```

The external seed fallback used for a token with no stored seed, or the zero
address when disabled. Set once at `initialize`; no setter.

### supportsInterface

```solidity
function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external view returns (bool)
```

Standard ERC165 check. True for ERC721, ERC165, EIP-2981 (`0x2a55205a`), and
ERC-4906 (`0x49064906`).

### symbol

```solidity
function symbol() external view returns (string)
```

Standard ERC721 collection symbol, set at init.

### tokenSeed

```solidity
function tokenSeed(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bytes32)
```

The seed for a token. Reverts `NeverMinted` for `tokenId == 0` or an id past
mints-ever. A stored seed is returned directly; an in-range token with no
stored seed falls back to `seedSource`. Readable for a burned id.

### tokenURI

```solidity
function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string)
```

Standard ERC721 metadata entry point. Reverts `ERC721NonexistentToken` for a
token that does not exist and delegates to the renderer's `tokenURI`.

### totalSupply

```solidity
function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256)
```

Live supply: mints ever minus burns.

### version

```solidity
function version() external view returns (uint256)
```

The implementation version, a compile-time constant: `2` for this generation.
The v1 core reports `1`. A new generation ships as a new implementation and
factory, so a collection reports the version it was cloned from.

## Events

### AdminSet

```solidity
event AdminSet(address indexed account, bool allowed)
```

Emitted when an admin key is granted (`allowed = true`) or revoked. Indexed by
`account`.

### Approval

```solidity
event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed approved, uint256 indexed tokenId)
```

Standard ERC721 single-token approval event. Indexed by `owner`, `approved`,
and `tokenId`.

### ApprovalForAll

```solidity
event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved)
```

Standard ERC721 operator approval event. Indexed by `owner` and `operator`,
with the `approved` flag.

### BatchMetadataUpdate

```solidity
event BatchMetadataUpdate(uint256 _fromTokenId, uint256 _toTokenId)
```

ERC-4906 range refresh, emitted by `setRenderer` and `setSupplyCap` (all
tokens) and by `notifyMetadataUpdate` (a renderer- or admin-chosen range).

### Burned

```solidity
event Burned(uint256 indexed tokenId)
```

Emitted when a token is burned. Indexed by `tokenId`.

### ContractURIUpdated

```solidity
event ContractURIUpdated()
```

ERC-7572 contract-level refresh, emitted by `setRenderer` alongside the
token-range refresh.

### CreatorListed

```solidity
event CreatorListed(address indexed creator, bool listed)
```

Emitted when the owner lists or unlists a creator, including each creator
seeded at init. Indexed by `creator`, with the `listed` flag. Confirmed status
is a live `isConfirmedCreator` read.

### Initialized

```solidity
event Initialized(uint64 version)
```

OpenZeppelin Initializable event, emitted once when the clone is initialized.

### MetadataUpdate

```solidity
event MetadataUpdate(uint256 _tokenId)
```

ERC-4906 single-token refresh, declared for interface completeness; range
refreshes use `BatchMetadataUpdate`.

### Minted

```solidity
event Minted(address indexed minter, address indexed to, uint256 firstTokenId, uint256 quantity, uint256 firstMintIndex)
```

Emitted once per mint call, from `mintTo` or `mintToSeeded`. Indexed by
`minter` (the authorized minter that issued the tokens) and `to` (the
recipient). A call covers ids `[firstTokenId, firstTokenId + quantity - 1]`.
`firstMintIndex` equals `firstTokenId`, kept as a separate field for indexer
ABI stability with v1. The mint block is the log's block. Payment and referral
are not here; the canonical minter emits its own `Sold`.

### MinterLocked

```solidity
event MinterLocked()
```

Emitted once when `lockMinter` runs, or when `seal` engages it.

### MinterSet

```solidity
event MinterSet(address indexed minter, bool allowed)
```

Emitted when a minter is granted or revoked, and once per initial minter at
init. Indexed by `minter`, with the `allowed` flag. The factory's
`SurfaceCreated` names the chosen primary minter directly (see
`PrimaryMinterSet` for the live pointer).

### OwnershipTransferred

```solidity
event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner)
```

Standard Ownable event, emitted at init when the first owner is set, when
`acceptOwnership` completes a transfer, and when `renounceOwnership` or `seal`
sets the owner to zero. Indexed by `previousOwner` and `newOwner`.

### OwnershipTransferStarted

```solidity
event OwnershipTransferStarted(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner)
```

Standard Ownable2Step event, emitted by `transferOwnership` when a pending
owner is recorded. Indexed by `previousOwner` and `newOwner`.

### PrimaryMinterSet

```solidity
event PrimaryMinterSet(address indexed minter)
```

Emitted whenever the frontend-discovery pointer changes: `setPrimaryMinter`, a
revoke of the current primary clearing it to zero, or the value seeded at
init. Indexed by `minter` (the new value, zero when cleared).

### RendererLocked

```solidity
event RendererLocked()
```

Emitted once when `lockRenderer` runs, for a lock set at init, or when `seal`
engages it.

### RendererSet

```solidity
event RendererSet(address indexed renderer)
```

Emitted when the renderer pointer changes. Indexed by `renderer`.

### RoyaltyLocked

```solidity
event RoyaltyLocked()
```

Emitted once when `lockRoyalty` runs, or when `seal` engages it.

### RoyaltySet

```solidity
event RoyaltySet(uint16 royaltyBps, address indexed royaltyReceiver)
```

Emitted when the royalty changes with `setRoyalty`, or when `lockRoyalty`/
`seal` snapshots a zero receiver to `owner()`. Indexed by `royaltyReceiver`.

### StrayETHRescued

```solidity
event StrayETHRescued(address indexed to, uint256 amount)
```

Emitted when `rescueStrayETH` sweeps force-fed ETH. Indexed by `to`, with the
`amount` in wei.

### SupplyCapSet

```solidity
event SupplyCapSet(uint256 supplyCap)
```

Emitted when the supply cap changes with `setSupplyCap`.

### SupplyLocked

```solidity
event SupplyLocked()
```

Emitted once when `lockSupply` runs, for a lock set at init, or when `seal`
engages it.

### SurfaceConfigured

```solidity
event SurfaceConfigured(IdMode idMode, uint256 supplyCap)
```

Emitted once at init with the id mode (always Sequential) and supply cap. The
cap has its own update event.

### Transfer

```solidity
event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId)
```

Standard ERC721 transfer event, emitted on mint (from the zero address),
transfer, and burn (to the zero address). Indexed by `from`, `to`, and
`tokenId`.

## Errors

**`AlreadyAdmin()`**

`addAdmin` was called for the owner or an existing admin.

**`BadSupplyCap(uint256 floor, uint256 requested)`**

`setSupplyCap` was given a nonzero cap below mints-ever.

**`ERC721IncorrectOwner(address sender, uint256 tokenId, address owner)`**

Standard ERC721 error: a token operation named an owner that does not match
the token's actual owner.

**`ERC721InsufficientApproval(address operator, uint256 tokenId)`**

Standard ERC721 error: the caller lacks approval to transfer or burn the
token.

**`ERC721InvalidApprover(address approver)`**

Standard ERC721 error: the approver is not authorized to grant the approval.

**`ERC721InvalidOperator(address operator)`**

Standard ERC721 error: an invalid operator address (for example the zero
address) was used in an approval.

**`ERC721InvalidOwner(address owner)`**

Standard ERC721 error: an invalid owner address (for example the zero
address) was used in an ownership query.

**`ERC721InvalidReceiver(address receiver)`**

Standard ERC721 error: a safe transfer targeted a contract that does not
accept ERC721 tokens (bad `onERC721Received`).

**`ERC721InvalidSender(address sender)`**

Standard ERC721 error: a transfer named a sender that does not own the token.

**`ERC721NonexistentToken(uint256 tokenId)`**

Standard ERC721 error: the token id does not exist (never minted or already
burned).

**`ExceedsCap(uint256 cap, uint256 attempted)`**

A mint would push mints-ever past the supply cap.

**`InvalidInitialization()`**

OpenZeppelin Initializable error: `initialize` was called more than once, or
on the implementation whose initializers are disabled.

**`MinterIsLocked()`**

`setMinter`, `setPrimaryMinter`, or `lockMinter` was called after
`lockMinter`.

**`NeverMinted()`**

`tokenSeed` was read for an id that was never minted.

**`NoStrayETH()`**

`rescueStrayETH` found a zero ETH balance.

**`NotAContract(address account)`**

Declared on the shared collection interface for companion use. The
collection's own checks raise `RendererNotContract` or `SeedSourceNotContract`
instead, so the collection does not raise this.

**`NotAnAdmin()`**

`removeAdmin` was called for an account that holds no grant.

**`NotAuthorized()`**

An `onlyOwnerOrAdmin` function was called by neither the owner nor an admin;
`removeAdmin` was called by someone other than the owner or the admin itself;
`notifyMetadataUpdate` was called by neither the renderer nor an owner/admin;
or `burn` was called without holder-or-approved authority.

**`NotInitializing()`**

OpenZeppelin Initializable error: an `onlyInitializing` step ran outside an
active initialization.

**`NotMinter()`**

A mint entrypoint was called by an address that is not an authorized minter.

**`OwnableInvalidOwner(address owner)`**

Standard OpenZeppelin Ownable error: an invalid owner address (for example the
zero address) was supplied.

**`OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address account)`**

Standard OpenZeppelin Ownable error: an owner-gated function (`addAdmin`,
`transferOwnership`, `renounceOwnership`, `seal`) was called by a non-owner,
or `acceptOwnership` by a non-pending-owner.

**`OwnerRequired()`**

`initialize` was given the zero address as the owner.

**`PrimaryMinterNotAuthorized()`**

`initialize` or `setPrimaryMinter` was given a nonzero primary minter that is
not a member of the granted minter set.

**`ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall()`**

OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard error: a `nonReentrant` function was re-entered.

**`RendererIsLocked()`**

`setRenderer` or `lockRenderer` was called after `lockRenderer`.

**`RendererNotContract(address renderer)`**

The renderer address has no code (carries the address). Raised by
`initialize` and `setRenderer`: a codeless renderer reverts `tokenURI`, and a
collection initialized `rendererLocked` could not recover.

**`RendererRequired()`**

`initialize` was given no renderer (neither the config nor the factory
default), or `setRenderer` was passed the zero address.

**`RescueFailed()`**

The transfer in `rescueStrayETH` reverted.

**`RoyaltyIsLocked()`**

`setRoyalty` or `lockRoyalty` was called after `lockRoyalty`.

**`RoyaltyTooHigh()`**

`initialize` or `setRoyalty` was given a royalty above the 50% cap (5000 bps).

**`SeedSourceNotContract(address seedSource)`**

`initialize` was given a nonzero `seedSource` with no code. `seedSource` has
no setter, so a codeless address would make `tokenSeed` revert forever for
every token it serves.

**`SelfCustodyRejected(uint256 tokenId)`**

A mint or transfer would land a token at this collection's own address. The
collection has no code path to move a token back out, so this is rejected
instead of stranding it.

**`SupplyIsLocked()`**

`setSupplyCap` or `lockSupply` was called after `lockSupply`.

**`ZeroAccount()`**

`rescueStrayETH` or `addAdmin` was passed the zero address.

**`ZeroMinter()`**

An initial minter in `initialize`, or the `setMinter` target, was the zero
address.

**`ZeroQuantity()`**

`mintTo` was called with `quantity == 0`, or `mintToSeeded` with an empty
`seeds` array.
